hero.title: PixVerse v5.6 Text-to-Video Generator
hero.description: Use PixVerse v5.6 Text-to-Video on joymagic to convert English or Chinese prompts into high-quality short videos. Flexible controls for resolution, duration and audio make it ideal for creators, brands and teams.

pixverse56Page.intro: PixVerse v5.6 Text-to-Video on joymagic is wired into our param-combination credit pricing system, so you can mix and match resolution, duration and audio settings while keeping text-to-video costs transparent, predictable and production-ready.

features.title: Why use PixVerse v5.6 Text-to-Video on joymagic?

multiResolution.title: Flexible resolution & duration grid
multiResolution.description: Supports 360p, 540p, 720p and 1080p with fixed 5 / 8 / 10 second presets. For 1080p, only 5s and 8s are allowed—10s is disabled in the UI and rejected in pricing checks to avoid unsupported combos.

audio.title: Optional audio generation
audio.description: Flip generate_audio_switch to add native audio. Pricing automatically maps to audio-on / audio-off parameter combinations so you always know what you’re paying for.

thinking.title: Smart thinking modes
thinking.description: thinking_type supports enabled, disabled and auto. Enabled favors quality, disabled favors speed, and auto lets the backend choose, which is usually the best default.

safety.title: Integrated safety & pricing controls
safety.description: Runs through joymagic’s safety policies and credit estimation. Unsupported combinations like 1080p × 10s are blocked both in the UI and in backend validation so you don’t waste time or credits.

q1.question: Which resolutions and durations does PixVerse v5.6 support?
q1.answer: PixVerse v5.6 currently supports 360p, 540p, 720p and 1080p, with durations of 5, 8 and 10 seconds. For 1080p, only 5s and 8s are available. The 1080p × 10s combination is disabled in the UI and treated as unsupported in pricing and backend validation.

q2.question: What does generate_audio_switch control?
q2.answer: generate_audio_switch toggles native audio generation. When off, you only pay for video; when on, an audio surcharge is added on top of the base video price via the param-combination pricing table.

q3.question: How do the thinking_type modes differ?
q3.answer: enabled turns on stronger reasoning for more stable composition and motion at the cost of some latency; disabled prioritizes speed; auto lets the service choose per request, which is recommended for most users.

q4.question: How can I get repeatable results?
q4.answer: Use the seed parameter. The default -1 uses a random seed each time; if you want similar outputs across runs, set a fixed seed value and reuse it in subsequent generations.

features.title: Why use PixVerse v5.6 Image-to-Video on joymagic?

imagePrompt.title: Image + prompt control
imagePrompt.description: Upload a reference image to lock in character identity, style or layout, then use a text prompt to describe motion, camera movement and scene transitions.

sharedPricing.title: Shared pricing grid with text-to-video
sharedPricing.description: Image-to-video uses the same 360p–1080p, 5 / 8 / 10 second, audio-on / audio-off grid as PixVerse v5.6 text-to-video, mapped through the same param-combination pricing table.

formats.title: Flexible output formats
formats.description: Choose between multiple aspect ratios, resolutions from 360p to 1080p, and fixed durations (5 / 8 / 10 seconds, with 1080p limited to 5s or 8s to avoid unsupported combos).

audio.title: Optional native audio
audio.description: Flip generate_audio_switch to add PixVerse native audio—ambience, music or light SFX that follow your visual motion—or turn it off when you just want silent clips.

q1.question: How is PixVerse image-to-video different from text-to-video?
q1.answer: Text-to-video generates everything from scratch using only your prompt. Image-to-video lets you upload a reference image to control character identity, style or composition while PixVerse animates it according to your prompt, which is ideal when you already have key visuals.

q2.question: Which resolutions and durations are supported for image-to-video?
q2.answer: Image-to-video follows the same grid as text-to-video: 360p, 540p, 720p and 1080p, with 5 / 8 / 10 second presets. For 1080p, only 5s and 8s are allowed—the 1080p × 10s combination is disabled in the UI and treated as unsupported in pricing and backend validation.

q3.question: Can I generate audio together with the video?
q3.answer: Yes. Enable generate_audio_switch to let PixVerse create synchronized audio for your clip. Pricing automatically switches to audio-inclusive parameter combinations so you always know when audio costs are included.

q4.question: Do I need both an image and a prompt?
q4.answer: Yes. The image anchors what the scene should look like, while the prompt describes how it should move. The playground validates that both fields are present before sending the request to avoid wasted credits.
